prompt: Create a clean transparent-background UI sprite for the private Baseball Heroes remake, using the supplied original LEVEL UP window screenshot only as a STYLE AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE, not as an edit target. Output a wide approximately 3:1 isolated header emblem, no panel or stadium. At the LEFT, a large five-point bright cyan-blue star-shaped level badge with thick midnight-blue ink outline, inset light-cyan rim, crisp angular blue facets, a small pale-blue highlight on its upper-left point. Leave the central area of this blue star entirely BLANK, with enough clear blue surface for a dynamic white two-digit level number to be drawn later by game code. No number, no letter or symbol inside the star. At the RIGHT, the exact text 'LEVEL UP!' in bold condensed arcade cartoon lettering, slightly italic, baseline tilted upward like the reference, with warm pale-yellow top highlights, saturated golden yellow lower faces, thick dark burnt-brown extruded outline and offset shadow. Long sharp burnt-brown tapered underline directly under the letters, as in the original. The star is roughly 22% of overall width, the lettering 75%, slight overlap at the left of the L only. Keep a coherent early-2010s Flash game illustrated style, strong flat shapes with 2-3 clean cel-shaded bevel bands, not photorealistic or 3D metal. Edges must be crisp at small UI size. Fit all points, full exclamation mark, underline and outlines inside generous transparent padding. No black/white background, no checkerboard, no glows extending far outside silhouette, no extra text, no coins, no panel, no lock, no decorative clutter. The finished sprite should be genuinely RGBA transparent.
